concept: It's okay to say 'no' when something doesn't feel right, even to a friend
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character says no to something that didn't feel right, even though a friend wanted them to do it
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did the character know it didn't feel right? What happened after they said no?
exercise.practice: Student practices saying 'no thank you' in a simple roleplay scenario

assessment.success_marker: student can say no clearly in the roleplay without over-apologizing or backing down
